subject: Money gone after installing an app
body: A seller on social media asked me to install an app to pay a RM5 booking fee. Two hours later RM6,200 was transferred out of my savings account without any OTP reaching me. Please stop any further transfers now.

subject: Caj tidak dikenali pada kad kredit
body: Saya nampak caj RM780 daripada sebuah laman web luar negara pada kad kredit saya semalam. Saya tidak pernah membuat pembelian ini. Tolong sekat kad saya dan siasat.

subject: Call claiming to be from Bank Negara
body: Someone called this afternoon saying he was from Bank Negara and that my account was linked to money laundering. I did not give him any details and ended the call. Reporting it in case it is useful to you.

subject: Suspicious email asking me to update my details
body: I received an email with your logo asking me to update my details through a link. The address looked wrong so I did not click anything. I am forwarding the wording so you can check it.

subject: My registered phone number was changed, not by me
body: I just got an email saying the mobile number on my online banking was changed. I did not request this. Whoever did it will now receive my OTPs. Please reverse it and lock my account immediately.

subject: Safe banking while travelling
body: I will be travelling for a few months next year. What is the safest way to use online banking on hotel wifi, and are there settings I should switch on beforehand?

subject: I gave my OTP to a caller
body: A caller said he was from your card centre and needed the OTP to cancel a suspicious charge. I read it out to him ten minutes ago and now I think it was a scam. Please block my card right now.

subject: Fourth visit and my documents were lost again
body: I have submitted my financing documents four times and each time the branch tells me they cannot find them. I have taken leave for every visit. I want the branch manager to call me and explain what is going on.

subject: Reporting this to Bank Negara tomorrow
body: A double deduction from six weeks ago is still not refunded despite five calls and two branch visits. I have had enough. Unless I receive a refund date by tomorrow I am filing a report with Bank Negara.

subject: No parking at your branch
body: Just a grumble. There is never any parking at your Cheras branch and the nearest car park is a ten minute walk. It puts me off visiting.

subject: Pegawai tidak menghubungi saya seperti dijanjikan
body: Pegawai anda berjanji akan menghubungi saya dalam masa dua hari tentang kes saya. Sudah dua minggu berlalu tanpa sebarang panggilan. Saya minta penjelasan mengapa perkara ini berlaku.

subject: My lawyer will be writing to you
body: Your bank reported me as a defaulter on a loan I settled in full two years ago, and my housing application was rejected because of it. I have asked my lawyer to send a letter of demand for the damage caused.

subject: Your hold music
body: The hold music on your hotline is the same thirty seconds on repeat. Not a big thing, but please change it one day.

subject: Wrong overdraft fee and staff laughed at me
body: I was charged an overdraft fee on an account that was never overdrawn. When I asked at the counter, the staff laughed and said it was my problem. I want the fee refunded and an apology.

subject: Not receiving TAC, must pay supplier today
body: I have not received any TAC on my phone since this morning, so I cannot make any transfers. I have to pay my supplier today or my shipment will be cancelled. Please fix this urgently.

subject: Bank confirmation letter for embassy
body: I need a bank confirmation letter showing my balance for an embassy appointment on the 12th of next month. How do I request one and how long does it take?

subject: Change my email address
body: Please let me know how I can change the email address on my account to a new one.

subject: Daftar DuitNow
body: Bagaimana cara untuk mendaftar DuitNow menggunakan nombor kad pengenalan saya? Adakah ia boleh dibuat melalui aplikasi?

subject: Cheque deposited five days ago still not cleared
body: I deposited a local cheque for RM3,400 five working days ago and the amount is still showing as uncleared. Normally it takes two days. Can you check what is holding it up?

subject: My account was closed and my salary is due tomorrow
body: I tried to log in today and was told my savings account has been closed. I never asked for that. My salary will be paid into it tomorrow and I have no other account. Please help me now.

subject: Savings rate
body: What is the current profit rate on your basic savings account?

subject: ATM in Bangkok kept my card and I have no cash
body: An ATM here in Bangkok has kept my debit card. I am travelling alone, have almost no cash and my flight home is in four days. I need a way to access my money urgently.

subject: 0% instalment for a hospital bill
body: I paid a hospital bill of RM7,200 with my credit card last week. Could I convert it to your 0% instalment plan over 12 months? Please tell me how to apply.

subject: New debit card has not arrived after three weeks
body: I applied for a replacement debit card three weeks ago and was told it would take seven working days. It has still not arrived. Can you check where it is?

subject: Cashback card for petrol
body: Do you have a credit card that gives cashback on petrol? What is the minimum income to apply?

subject: Kad ditolak di kaunter hospital
body: Kad debit saya ditolak di kaunter hospital sekarang walaupun baki akaun mencukupi. Anak saya perlu dimasukkan ke wad dan saya perlu bayar deposit. Tolong bantu saya segera.

subject: Charged twice for one meal
body: A restaurant charged my credit card twice for the same meal last Saturday, RM120 each time. The restaurant says to ask the bank. Please reverse one of the charges.

subject: Change card statement date
body: Can the statement date on my credit card be moved to the start of the month?

subject: Auction notice for my house
body: I received a notice that my house will be put up for auction in two weeks because of arrears on my home financing. I can pay the arrears in full this week. Please tell me who to speak to so the auction is stopped.

subject: Lost my job, cannot pay car instalment
body: I was retrenched last week and will not be able to pay my car instalment from next month. Is there any deferment or reduced payment I can apply for?

subject: Personal financing for government staff
body: What is your personal financing rate for government servants and the maximum amount I can apply for?

subject: Disbursement to developer is late
body: The developer says your disbursement for my home financing is three weeks overdue and they will start charging me late interest from this Friday. Your branch keeps saying it is being processed. Please release the payment before Friday.

subject: Penyata baki pembiayaan
body: Boleh saya dapatkan penyata baki pembiayaan peribadi saya bagi tahun 2025 untuk simpanan rekod saya?

subject: Instalment deducted twice this month
body: My personal financing instalment of RM640 was deducted twice from my account this month, on the 5th and again on the 7th. Please refund the extra deduction.

subject: Top up my home loan
body: I am thinking of renovating next year. Is it possible to top up my existing home financing, and what would the rate be?

subject: Double your crypto in 7 days
body: Join thousands of investors earning guaranteed returns. Deposit today and double your crypto in one week. Limited slots available.

subject: Well done to your Seremban team
body: The team at your Seremban branch stayed past closing time to help me sort out my late mother's paperwork. I am very grateful. Please let them know.

subject: Permohonan kerja
body: Saya graduan perakaunan dan berminat untuk memohon jawatan di bank anda. Bolehkah saya tahu cara untuk menghantar resume?

subject: Pest control services for your branches
body: We provide licensed pest control for commercial premises across the Klang Valley. May we send you a quotation for your branches?

subject: Class of 2010 reunion
body: Hi all, the reunion dinner is confirmed for the first Saturday of December. Reply to this email if you are coming so we can book enough tables.

subject: Donation appeal for flood relief
body: Our association is collecting donations for families affected by the recent floods. We would be grateful if Bank Contoh could contribute or share our appeal.

subject: Invitation: fintech careers fair
body: Our university is hosting a careers fair in March and would like to invite Bank Contoh to set up a booth. Details are attached.
